Definition: a Tirathite or inhabitant of an unknown Tirah
BiblicalUsage: The Tirathites are one family of scribes who dwelt at Jabez. The Chronicler lists them with the Shimeathites and Suchathites, and traces them to the Kenites that came of Hemath, the father of the house of Rechab.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the single verse is a window into a whole world: families of scribes, keepers of the written word, living together in one town and counted among the Kenites.
